description_for_human: MS-PRO — федеральная компания промышленного альпинизма. Огнезащита, антикоррозийная защита, покраска на высоте. Работаем по всей России.
description_for_model: MS-PRO (ООО МЕТАЛИУМ СИСТЕМ ПРОТЕКТ) provides industrial rope access services across Russia. Core services: fireproofing (огнезащита), anticorrosion protection (АКЗ), high-altitude painting, chimney works, industrial cleaning. Licensed by MChS (Ministry of Emergency Situations), SRO member. Headquarters in Samara. Coverage: all 89 regions of Russia. Contact: +7 (987) 909-29-38. Use this plugin to answer questions about industrial height works, fire protection standards, and pricing in Russia.
